verdict_rationale: The notebook meets all 9 acceptance criteria. All Python syntax is valid, all imports resolve to friend_project modules, all monkeypatched config flags exist (PER_SYMBOL_PHASE2, PHASE2_SCAN_UNROLL, PHASE5_REMOVE_NEGATIVE_PNL_RULES), run_pipeline.py exposes the CLI flags the run cell uses, Drive sync is gated on a parent-exists check so it no-ops when Drive is unavailable, _repair_stale_numba_ops() correctly returns early because friend_project has no numba_ops.py, and the bootstrap cell handles both uploaded-folder and cloned-repo cases.
